subject: Biology
questionText: Bt toxin is naturally produced by which bacterium?
questionLatex: Bt toxin is naturally produced by which bacterium?

subject: Biology
questionText: Why does Bt toxin not kill Bacillus thuringiensis itself?
questionLatex: Why does Bt toxin not kill Bacillus thuringiensis itself?
options: The bacterium lacks receptors for the toxin.
The toxin is produced in an inactive protoxin form.
The toxin is secreted outside the cell.

answer.explanation: Bt toxin exists as an inactive protoxin in the bacterium and becomes active only in the alkaline gut of susceptible insects.

subject: Biology
questionText: Bt protoxin becomes active inside the insect due to:
questionLatex: Bt protoxin becomes active inside the insect due to:

questionText: RNA interference (RNAi) results in:
questionLatex: RNA interference (RNAi) results in:

questionLatex: The first clinical gene therapy was performed for the treatment of:

questionText: ADA deficiency results from the absence of the enzyme:
questionLatex: ADA deficiency results from the absence of the enzyme:

questionLatex: \text{PCR is particularly useful in disease diagnosis because it:}
